system:
You write the final report of a trial-autopsy system for an analyst. Plain language, precise,
no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

Return JSON only:
{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",
 "summary": "<3-5 sentences: what happened or is expected, why, how sure>",
 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],
 "what_would_change_this": "<one or two sentences>",
 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

response: {"headline": "The OCEAN(a) outcomes trial of olpasiran cannot be forecast due to insufficient data; enrollment is complete but the event count and on-treatment Lp(a) reduction at the phase 3 dose are unknown.", "summary": "The phase 3 OCEAN(a) trial randomized 7,297 patients with Lp(a) ≥200 nmol/L to olpasiran or placebo, with a primary endpoint of time to CHD death, myocardial infarction, or urgent coronary revascularization over a planned 5-year median follow-up (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05581303). Human genetics strongly support Lp(a) as causal for coronary disease (Open Targets LPA score 0.922; Mendelian randomization odds ratios 1.8–3.67) (opentargets:LPA; Genetic variants associated with Lp(a) lipoprotein level and coronary disease). Phase 2 data show potent but waning Lp(a) reduction: −97.4% at week 36 declining to −27.9% at week 96 for the 75 mg Q12W dose (Small Interfering RNA to Reduce Lipoprotein(a) in Cardiovascular Disease; The Off-Treatment Effects of Olpasiran on Lipoprotein(a) Lowering: OCEAN(a)-DOSE Extension Period Results). The phase 3 dose regimen is not confirmed in verified facts, and no placebo-adjusted phase 3 biomarker change is available. The calculator estimates an expected hazard ratio of 0.82 (18% relative risk reduction) but requires 796 events for 80% power; the actual event count is unknown because the trial has not read out (calculator). The forecast is therefore 'not_computable' with medium confidence, driven primarily by missing event and biomarker data rather than a demonstrated small treatment effect.", "key_evidence": ["7,297 participants randomized (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05581303)", "Inclusion threshold: Lp(a) ≥200 nmol/L (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05581303)", "Primary endpoint: time to CHD death, MI, or urgent coronary revascularization; ~5 years median follow-up (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05581303)", "Phase 2 biomarker effect wanes from −97.4% at week 36 to −27.9% at week 96 for 75 mg Q12W dose (Small Interfering RNA to Reduce Lipoprotein(a) in Cardiovascular Disease; The Off-Treatment Effects of Olpasiran on Lipoprotein(a) Lowering: OCEAN(a)-DOSE Extension Period Results)", "Genetic evidence: Open Targets LPA score 0.922; Mendelian randomization ORs 1.8–3.67 for coronary disease (opentargets:LPA; Genetic variants associated with Lp(a) lipoprotein level and coronary disease)", "Calculator output: expected HR 0.82, causal RRR 18%, category insufficient_data, weakest link trial size (events) unknown; 796 events needed for 80% power (calculator)"], "what_would_change_this": "A placebo-adjusted Lp(a) reduction from phase 3 at the trial dose and background therapy, together with the total events accrued and observed hazard ratio with confidence interval at primary analysis.", "readthrough_note": "Other Lp(a)-lowering programmes in outcomes trials include pelacarsen (Lp(a) antisense, HORIZON trial) and lepodisiran (LPA siRNA); their readouts will inform whether sustained Lp(a) reduction translates to cardiovascular benefit in high-Lp(a) populations."}
